nodes.name: 🚪 ENTRY — Webhook Receiver
nodes.notes:
═══════════════════════════════════
 ENTRY POINT — All chatbot requests land here
───────────────────────────────────
 Expected POST body:
 {
   "action": "START" | "INQUIRY_START" | ...
   "userPhone": "010xxxxxxxx"
   "department": "السجل المدني"
   "service": "استخراج بطاقة"
 }
 No authentication required for graduation demo.
═══════════════════════════════════

nodes.name: 🔀 ROUTER — Main Action Switch
nodes.notes:
═══════════════════════════════════
 CENTRAL ROUTER
 Routes action string → correct flow branch
───────────────────────────────────
 Outputs (in order):
 [0] MAIN_MENU
 [1] MAIN_MENU (MENU)
 [2] MAIN_MENU (RESTART)
 [3] INQUIRY_DEPT
 [4] INQUIRY_SERVICES
 [5] SERVICE_DETAIL
 [6] BOOK_DEPT
 [7] BOOK_SERVICES
 [8] BOOK_SAVE
 [9] WORK_HOURS
 [10] FALLBACK
═══════════════════════════════════
